name: Sprint and Board Queries
description: Lets TPM answer natural language sprint and board questions by forming JQL and querying Jira read only via the Atlassian MCP.

boardId.label: Board Id
boardId.description: The Jira agile board whose active sprint is queried. Leave empty to query by project and openSprints without a specific board.

boardUrl.label: Board URL
boardUrl.description: Optional board URL referenced in answers so the user can open the board directly.

resultFormat.label: Result Format
resultFormat.description: How results are presented: a compact table, grouped by status or assignee, or a plain list.

includeDoneInSprintView.label: Include Done In Sprint View
includeDoneInSprintView.description: Whether a general what is in the sprint answer includes Done items or focuses on active work.
